d: Bihar ke Nitish Setu par postar pharne ka ek vidiyo soshal midiya par vayral hone ke bad siyasat garma gaee hai. PM Modi ke udghatan ke kuchh ghanton bad samne aae is vidiyo men kuchh log NDA ke postar aur bainar pharte najar aa rahe hain. vidiyo men RJD ke jhande aur Lalu Prasad Yadav va Tejashwi Yadav ke samarthan men narebaji bhi dikhaee-sunaee dene ka dava kiya ja raha hai.
